graph.normalization: NFKC, case-fold, whitespace; split only pipe delimiters. Names are metadata strings, not resolved human identities.
graph.scoring: Weighted cosine over shared typed features. weight=(2 for author else 1)*(1+ln((N+1)/(degree+1))). No embeddings, LLM, behavioral or availability score.
